trust_decision.summary: Not a trust decision but an algorithmic-cost bound: untrusted Markdown attribute syntax ({.c}, {#id}) decides how many attribute nodes/lines are merged into one target, and the merge/target-resolution code in the Attributes extension does work proportional to everything merged so far (re-splitting the accumulated class list, re-walking sibling chains), giving quadratic time.

landing_point.why: The summary names the Attributes extension and the prior advisory GHSA-g2gp-3wwq-f4ph was fixed in findTargetAndDirection here (early break at src/Extension/Attributes/Event/AttributesListener.php:96-107); the listener is where all attribute nodes are resolved and merged.

fix_sites.entry_point: MarkdownConverter::convert() / MarkdownParser::parse() with AttributesExtension (DocumentParsedEvent listener) - repeated inline or block {.class} on one target
same convert()/parse(); chains of TARGET_NEXT attribute blocks re-walked per block
same convert()/parse(); consecutive {.c} lines merged into one Attributes block during block parsing

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All changed sites sit in src/Extension/Attributes/; the parse-time continue parser (src/Extension/Attributes/Parser/AttributesBlockContinueParser.php:56-63) is a second accumulation point but is in the same extension directory, not an out-of-scope-looking module.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver fixing the listener could argue the multi-line {.c} merge in AttributesBlockContinueParser is a parse-time concern bounded by line count, not the listener bug the report describes.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Class ordering and merge semantics must be preserved: prefix attributes put their classes before the target's, suffix after; a later non-class merge result without 'class' resets the list; id/other keys are overwritten last-wins; filterAttributes (on* removal, allowlist, unsafe href/src) must still run per merge.

O6_input_shapes: inline attributes repeated on one block ({.c}{.c}...)
block attribute paragraphs separated by blank lines all targeting the parent ({.c}\n\n repeated)
consecutive attribute lines merged into one block ({.c}\n repeated)
chains of TARGET_NEXT attribute blocks kept adjacent by self-erasing link reference definitions ({#a}\n[a]: u\n repeated)
class value as string vs list (classList handles both, fix.diff:267-274)

O7_producer.where: No schema/serializer/cache/config producer; state is the in-memory AST node data 'attributes' written by the listener itself (src/Extension/Attributes/Event/AttributesListener.php:66).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: per-node mergeAttributes of configured defaults; a variant that re-merges per matching descendant into one shared node would reintroduce the accumulated-class re-split
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Uses the same AttributesHelper::mergeAttributes and node->data 'attributes' read-modify-write pattern as the listener; a maintainer adding e.g. propagate-to-parent defaults would naturally loop merges.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: alignment class merged into cell attributes via the same helper; a per-row/column accumulation into a shared node would be the same quadratic shape
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Already calls mergeAttributes on stored attributes; extending it to accumulate classes across cells is a plausible feature.
